name: issuezscore

queries.label: main
queries.sql_text:
SELECT
  i.issue_key,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(i.original_project, ''), b.name) AS project_name,
  i.created_date,
  i.resolution_date,
  i.status,
  i.url,
  i.title,
  i.lead_time_minutes,
  i.component,
  CASE
    WHEN :from = 0 OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(i.resolution_date) >= :from THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS in_display_range
FROM devlake.issues i
JOIN devlake.board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN devlake.boards b ON b.id = bi.board_id
WHERE bi.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(:boardScopes, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
      project_key VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_key',
      project_name VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_name',
      board_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.board_id',
      connection_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.connection_id'
    )) AS selected_scope
    WHERE ((selected_scope.project_key <> '' AND selected_scope.project_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.issue_key, '-', 1))
      OR (selected_scope.project_name <> '' AND selected_scope.project_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = i.original_project))
      AND (selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(bi.board_id, ':', -1))
      AND (selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(bi.board_id, ':', 3), ':', -1))
  )
  AND bi.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND (:hasIssueScope = 1 AND (COALESCE(NULLIF(i.original_project, ''), b.name) IN (:projectnames) OR SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.issue_key, '-', 1) IN (:projectKeys)))
  AND (:filterExclude = 0 OR COALESCE(NULLIF(i.original_project, ''), b.name) NOT IN (:excludeProjects))
  AND (:hasUserwhitelist = 0 OR i.assignee_name IN (:userwhitelist))
  AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
  AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(i.resolution_date) >= :lookbackTo
  AND (:to = 0 OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(i.resolution_date) <= :to)
GROUP BY i.issue_key, i.original_project, b.name, i.created_date, i.resolution_date,
         i.status, i.url, i.title, i.lead_time_minutes, i.component
ORDER BY i.resolution_date DESC
